title: Concept: unencrypted HTTP transport
description: The observed URL uses http, so the request line, headers, cookies and body cross the network in cleartext and any on-path device can read or rewrite them. The weakness belongs to the URL that was fetched, not to any header, which is why this record is decided from the scheme alone.
applicability: Any http:// observation, including API calls, document loads and asset fetches.
risk: Cleartext exposure of credentials, session cookies and content; MEDIUM severity because exploitation needs a position on the path.
